entries.title: Psalms 76:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph: a Song.>> In Judah is God known, his name is great in Israel;

entries.title: Psalms 76:2
segments: And in Salem is his tent, and his dwelling-place in Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 76:3
segments: There broke he the flashings of the bow, shield and sword and battle. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 76:4
segments: More glorious art thou, more excellent, than the mountains of prey.

entries.title: Psalms 76:5
segments: The stout-hearted are made a spoil, they have slept their sleep; and none of the men of might have found their hands.

entries.title: Psalms 76:6
segments: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 76:7
segments: ¶Thou, thou art to be feared, and who can stand before thee when once thou art angry?

entries.title: Psalms 76:8
segments: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from the heavens; the earth feared, and was still,

entries.title: Psalms 76:9
segments: When God rose up to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 76:10
segments: For the fury of man shall praise thee; the remainder of fury wilt thou gird on thyself.

entries.title: Psalms 76:11
segments: Vow and pay unto Jehovah your God: let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that is to be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 76:12
segments: He cutteth off the spirit of princes; [he] is terrible to the kings of the earth.
